nodes.label: Renderer not part of atom_t
nodes.rationale: Avoids cross-core LUT race and a second 8 KiB LUT (design.md §4.2)

nodes.rationale: The whole of the Atom's I/O; port C output latches kept separate from inputs or MOS read-modify-write corrupts mode bits; BSR path required.

nodes.rationale: Fitted by default because the MOS reads #B80C (PCR) on every character and spins on open bus without it.

nodes.label: Switch-dispatched 6502 interpreter
nodes.rationale: Dense switch compiles to a table branch on Cortex-M33 with no call overhead, keeps CPU state in registers.

nodes.label: Clocks, Voltage and Overclocking
nodes.rationale: Five things derive from clk_sys and each breaks differently; CPU-bound code scales purely with clock.

nodes.label: Status LED (pico_status_led)
nodes.rationale: On a W board the LED lives on the CYW43, so lighting it powers the radio; bring the driver up once.

nodes.label: clk_peri does not follow clk_sys
nodes.rationale: set_sys_clock_pll parks clk_peri at 48 MHz; re-apply SPI baud after every clock change.

nodes.label: Chained DMA Audio Ring
nodes.rationale: Power-of-two aligned ring with hardware read wrap replays instead of playing adjacent RAM on IRQ starvation; re-arm both read address and transfer count.

nodes.label: Polled DMA Ping-Pong Line-Buffer Blit
nodes.rationale: Poll rather than interrupt so audio owns its DMA IRQ; drain RX FIFO and clear overrun; restore 8-bit; leave interrupts enabled.

nodes.label: SD Card on spi0
nodes.rationale: Use a temporary file and explicit publish/recovery; rename alone does not prove power-loss atomicity.

nodes.label: Audio Refill Deadline (~3.5 ms) and IRQ Priority 0x40
nodes.norm_label: audio refill deadline (~3.5 ms) and irq priority 0x40
nodes.rationale: Everything about audio reduces to the refill deadline; DMA_IRQ_0 at 0x40 preempts default-priority handlers; refill path __not_in_flash_func.

nodes.label: The 40 ns Chip-Select Rule
nodes.rationale: spi_set_format and D/CX write must precede CS low so the instructions themselves supply the CS-high gap; otherwise intermittent corrupt pixels that look like wiring faults.

nodes.label: LCD Only Touched from Thread Context
nodes.norm_label: lcd only touched from thread context
nodes.rationale: A cursor timer drawing from IRQ forced the driver to mask interrupts, causing audio stutter; timers now set flags.

nodes.label: Count PCM Underruns Separately from Late Refills
nodes.norm_label: count pcm underruns separately from late refills
nodes.rationale: A PCM queue can starve at 14,000-18,000 samples/s with zero late DMA refills; one counter cannot replace the other.

nodes.label: FatFs copied from SDK at configure time
nodes.norm_label: fatfs copied from sdk at configure time

nodes.label: PICO_ATOM_HAVE_FONT detection

nodes.rationale: Byte-identical to XRoar font-6847.c, GPL-3.0-or-later, same licence as project

nodes.label: Band Renderer / Compact Snapshot
nodes.rationale: A 256x192 1-bit snapshot is 6,144 bytes and can be expanded into one 640-byte RGB565 row; keep it immutable until the present finishes.

nodes.label: CASET/RASET Windows and RGB565
nodes.rationale: Window setup is under a microsecond of wire, so splitting a present into many windows is nearly free.

nodes.label: Dirty-Region Tile Tracking
nodes.rationale: Over-mark rather than under-mark; snapshot and clear before sending.

nodes.rationale: 520 KiB must cover SRAM code, static buffers, both stacks, DMA and heap; keep fixed capacities in one header because they are traded against each other.

nodes.label: Core 1 Owns Slow Peripherals
nodes.rationale: Core 0 runs simulation and audio, core 1 the LCD and southbridge, with immutable frame handoff and a bounded input queue.

nodes.rationale: rp2350.cfg resets cores individually; reset run restarts core 0 which launches core 1, then OpenOCD resets core 1 into the bootrom. reset halt then resume holds both cores.

nodes.rationale: The default alarm pool's IRQ belongs to core 0; busy_wait_us_32 on core 1 cut core 0 cost per emulated instruction 1.11x.
